data_facts_with_para.paragraph: According to KPMG’s latestResidential Property Market Outlook, house prices across Australia are expected to rise 3.3 per cent over the year, followed by a stronger 6 per cent in 2026.

facts.fact_content: House prices across Australia are expected to rise 3.3% over the year.
House prices across Australia are expected to rise 6% in 2026.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Canberra and Melbourne are expected to rise by 3.5 per cent, Sydney by 3.3 per cent, and Brisbane by 3.1 per cent.

facts.fact_content: Canberra and Melbourne are expected to rise by 3.5%.
Sydney is expected to rise by 3.3%.
Brisbane is expected to rise by 3.1%.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Unit prices are forecast to rise by 5 per cent in Sydney and Perth in 2025.
